ideas.name: C1: Interaction screening by importance
ideas.description: Fit TreeHFD with interaction_order=1 to get main effects. Then rank variable pairs by how often they co-occur on tree paths, or by the variance of the residual explained by a pair, and pass only the top-k pairs as interaction_list. This avoids noisy, unneeded interactions and cuts runtime. Choose k on a validation split.

ideas.name: C2: Depth-limited variable selection
ideas.description: Sweep depth_variable over small values (e.g. 2 to 6). Fit TreeHFD for each on training data and compute Residual MSE on a validation split. Keep the depth with the best validation MSE and runtime tradeoff. This addresses the shallow-tree limit and finds the depth where the decomposition is most faithful.

ideas.name: C3: Component-wise ridge recalibration
ideas.description: Fit TreeHFD, predict the components on a held-out calibration set, and regress the model's predictions on the intercept plus all components with non-negative ridge regression. Apply the learned scalar weights to each component on test data. Each component stays a function of its own variables, and the systematic residual bias shrinks.
